payload.title: Page actions: Copy Markdown, View as Markdown, Open in AI assistants
payload.description: Standard front-end component (on by default for article/guide pages, configurable per site): primary 'Copy Markdown' (purpose-built page Markdown with title and canonical URL), dropdown 'View as Markdown' and optional 'Open in ChatGPT/Claude/Perplexity' (prompt with the canonical URL only; explicit user action). Accessible menu button, theme tokens, no-JS fallback link. Pairs with agent-readable pages PPY-f172d7.
